results.Summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2019 Ford F-150 ... equipped with an engine block heater.   Water and contaminants may get into the block heater cable's splice connector causing corrosion and damage.
results.Consequence: When the heater is plugged in, prolonged corrosion could cause a resistive short, increasing the risk of overheated or melted wiring which can increase the risk of a fire.
results.Remedy: Ford will notify owners, and dealers will disable the block heater cable, free of charge.  Ford's number for this recall is 18S45.

results.Summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2019 Ford F-150 ... previously remedied under recall 18V894.
results.Consequence: A damaged cable could cause a resistive short, increasing the risk of a fire.
results.Remedy: Ford will notify owners, and dealers will disable the engine block heater from being used.

results.Summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2017 F-150 ... crew cab.
results.Consequence: The seat occupant may not be adequately restrained, increasing their risk of injury.
results.Remedy: Ford will notify owners, and dealers will inspect the seat belt assembly.

results.summary: While operating my 2016 Ford F-150, the vehicle lost power-steering assist.
Uncommanded downshift from 4th gear into 1st gear at highway speed.
I placed the transmission selector in park and the truck rolled.
While driving 60 MPH, the transmission unexpectedly downshifted.
